scope: Outcome-blind component/rank anatomy for fixed C1/C2/C4 formulas; no policy, era, candidate, or outcome selection.
interpretation: C1 score rank is dominated by the residual-reversal numerator (median daily Spearman -0.9599 because lower residual is preferred); beta-market and volatility components are secondary on this rank diagnostic.
C4 score rank is likewise dominated by negative 20-session return (median daily Spearman -0.9519); path-length normalization is materially weaker on rank association.

C2 is an interaction: score rank has moderate association with ret_5 (median 0.2681) and near-zero median association with log abnormal turnover (-0.0045), while selected Top-30 names are elevated on both component percentiles.
All finite C1/C2/C4 recomputed scores exactly match the guarded feature artifact; this is a formula-consistency check, not scientific or predictive validation.
